info.title: freightctl governed record projection review
info.description: Governed root-admin record processing review and durable intent/attempt/held-output lifecycle. Runtime PostgreSQL,served clients,process-death recovery and full typed-workflow/browser/MCP acceptance remain owed. Structural schemas do not establish live authority or byte acceptance. Schema2 scoped-record-projection-v1 requires read/write/check_run and the appropriate workflow action grant;it supplies no root administration,policy-change,release or delivery grant.

post.summary: Review exact source proof and separate held output requirements
post.description: Requires root admin, read, write, intake_manage, check_run, check_release and original acceptance ownership. Source must have passed or released checks with live mandatory protections. A retired source contract is usable only for explicitly authorized processing; ordinary download policy stays unchanged. No payload is opened, no intent or artifact is written, and no model or scanner daemon is contacted. 32 KiB strict JSON, depth 16, 4096 tokens; unknown, duplicate/case-folded fields and trailing values refuse. Receiving alone grants no processing, forwarding or release authority.
